svg.title: Held-out QPSK points recovered through the physical path
svg.desc: All 4,296 directly observed held-out QPSK symbols form four tight recovered clusters. No bit error was observed among 8,592 scored bits.
svg.text: The message survived the complete physical path
Every directly observed held-out symbol is plotted; ideal states are marked by crosses.
Early telemetry fixed epoch timing, orientation, clock scale,
and affine gain. Held-out phase tracking used received I/Q,
not held-out symbol truth. Missing telemetry epochs remain absent.
Finite block result: 4,296 held-out symbols / 8,592 bits. This is not a claim of zero general BER.
